trace.question: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.

attempts.sql:
SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

trace.final_sql:
SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
trace.answer: More than 1,000 schools meet the criterion. The first 20 are shown with their full street addresses, starting with Alameda County Community (313 West Winton Avenue, Hayward, CA 94544-1136) and California School for the Deaf-Fremont (39350 Gallaudet Drive, Fremont, CA 94538-2308). The enrollment figures themselves aren't included in the result.
